text.p: Armor Holdings Inc said on Friday it has completed a public offering of four million shares of common stock at a price of $10-1/8 per share.

Net proceeds to the company from the offering, estimated at $37.3 million, will be used to reduce outstanding borrowings under its credit facility, for working capital purposes and potentially to finance future acquisitions.
Certain stockholders have granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 600,000 additional shares of common stock to cover over-allotments, Armor Holdings said in a statement.
Settlement and closing of the offering is expected to take place on July 30, 1997, the company said.
Dillon Read & Co Inc. is acting as lead manager of the underwriters for the offering and Equitable Securities Corp and Stephens Inc are acting as co-managers, the company said.
